title.narrative: Health Equity and Performance Improvement Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objectives of the proposed project are to: (i) increase access of targeted underserved rural communities to quality basic health services known to help reduce under-five child mortality; and (ii) support the development of strategic planning, regulatory, and monitoring mechanisms known to improve health system performance.

The objectives of the Health Equity and Performance Improvement Project for Panama are to: (i) increase access of targeted underserved rural communities to quality basic health services known to improve mother and child health; and (ii) support the development of strategic planning, regulatory, and monitoring mechanisms known to improve health system performance. There are three components to the project. The first component is the ensuring access to primary health care services by the poor in rural areas. The objective of this component is to increase access by targeted underserved communities to basic health services known to improve mother and child health care. This component will use capitation payments as a disbursement mechanism. This component will finance, on a declining basis, capitation payments to health regions to implement Health Protection Program for the Poor and Other Vulnerable Populations (PSPV). The objective of the second component is to increase the capacity of primary health care networks to respond to health care service demand by poor and indigenous rural communities. Finally, the third component will support strengthening the Ministry of Health's (MoH) institutional capacity for strategic planning, management of information, and monitoring results to improve the health system performance with a focus on fostering equitable access to quality health services.

comment.narrative: Demographic Household Survey (DHS) not conducted before in Panama.
TORs were finalized at the end of April 2014

title.narrative: Percentage of individuals from rural areas diagnosed with diabetes & hypertension in need of medication receiving prescribed drugs by primary health care units according to MINSA#s protocol.

comment.narrative: This baseline is of all people receiving treatment, regardless of whether the treatment is the one set in the MOH protocols. Atthemoment, MOH is revising information system so it can obtain information on whether they are receiving the correct treatment.
Target for Year 5 as per Dec 2012 restructuring.

This data, while below the baseline, captures the number of individuals receiving prescribed drugs according to the MOH protocolwhich differs from the baseline which captured all individuals receiving prescribed drugs regardless of whether or not it was inaccordance with MOH protocol.

title.narrative: % of drugs from the Primary Health Care Level Essential Drug List that is available at health centers.

comment.narrative: This baseline was supposed to be established during calendar year 1. However, the information was only recently collected.
Target for Year 5 as per Dec 2012 restructuring.
Trainings continue to take place on the dissemination of the essential drug list.

title.narrative: Percentage of children < 1 year with full vaccination scheme.

comment.narrative: This is both a custom and a core indicator. The PAD did not have a baseline but will provide this baseline at the first year ofprovision which is the data provided at end of 2010
Target for Year 5 as per Dec 2012 restructuring.
Indicator achieved and surpassed.

title.narrative: Percentage of pregnant women from the total estimated target population with at least 3 prenatal controls (one in each trimester).

comment.narrative: This is both a custom and a core indicator. The PAD did not provide a baseline, indicating that the baseline would be provided bythe end of the first year of project implementation. The numerator for this indicator is the number of pregnant women having had atleast 3 prenatal controls while the denominator is the number of estimated pregnant women in the beneficiary population.
Target for Year 5 as per Dec 2012 restructuring.
Indicator achieved and surpassed.
